decks.summary: Power Word Marie who commands enemies with a fully upgraded Power Word, calls Summoned Hounds, keeps doom out with Ghastly Possession for her extra spell action, and investigates with Dowsing Rod.
Combo Marie who recharges Archaic Glyphs (Guiding Stones) through Lost Arcana for repeated big clue turns, supported by Spirit Athame and Eyes of the Dreamer.
Triple-threat Marie who fights with Shrivelling, investigates with Magnifying Glass and Drawn to the Flame, and keeps doom on David Renfield for her extra spell action.
Solo Marie feeding David Renfield's money into Arcane Studies and keeping doom on him for her extra spell action, with Shrivelling to fight and Flashlight and Magnifying Glass for clues.
Spell-event Marie casting Spectral Razor, Read the Signs, Occult Invocation and Blood Eclipse, replaying them with De Vermis Mysteriis, and passing tests with Prophetic.
Solo Marie built toward Dayana Esperence to replay bonded spells like Blood-Rite, with David Renfield holding the doom for her extra action and Hawk-Eye Folding Camera for clues.
Level 0 solo Marie reaching 7 willpower and 7 intellect with St. Hubert's Key and Mr. "Rook", casting Storm of Spirits, Read the Signs and Spectral Razor; her ability is a bonus, not the plan.
Doom-and-action Marie who parks doom on assets that Elle Rubash lets her ignore, then spends the extra spell action on Clairvoyance, Divination and Shrivelling (5).
Marie on Arcane Research upgrades, with Alyssa Graham and Arcane Initiate for doom, Archaic Glyphs and Hawk-Eye Folding Camera for clues, and Shrivelling to fight.
Action-chaining Marie who juggles doom with Blood of Thoth, David Renfield and Cat Mask for Rogue-length turns, investigating with Dowsing Rod and Clairvoyance.
